constraints: N1..50,M1..1000,P1..12;connected undirected roads;exact two-decimal nonnegative costs;positive savings;duplicate offer stores allowed;must return home.
independentMethod: Dijkstra from relevant vertices followed by minimum-cost Held-Karp tours with separately accumulated subset profits; all ordered subset tours brute-forced for small instances.
